description.en:
Starts scripted camera control for an event: creates a fresh camera-control state, takes the camera's current position and look-at point as the starting point (CamCtrlReset), and clears the character to follow (CamCtrlLookAtChara(_hcam, 0, 0)).
Events call it once near the start, with the active camera, and CamCtrlExit at the end.
The camera-control helpers keep their state in subev_ctx.cam_ctrl, the context of an event started by CallEvent. While such an event runs, CallEvent calls sysCamCtrlStep every frame: it applies the engine's camera move (CMND_GET_MOVE_INFO_CAMERA) to the camera, keeps the look-at point on the followed character when there is one, and marks the move as finished once it is over (see IsCamCtrlMove).

examples.case: Start and end of camera control in an event (real usage, from ev42010200.nut)
